record.oneLiner: The archetypal armoured dinosaur, with a bony tail club.
record.description: Ankylosaurus was a heavily armoured dinosaur from the very end of the Cretaceous in western North America, and the largest known ankylosaurid at 6–8 m long. Its broad, low body was covered in bony plates (osteoderms), and its tail ended in a large bony club. It was among the last non-avian dinosaurs.

notableFacts.text: Its tail ended in a large bony club, likely used in defence.
Covered in bony plates (osteoderms), even over the eyelids.
'Fused lizard' — many of its bones were fused together for strength.
